column1: # Kernel.PayCellDomain: Objective contract manifest. Written by `scripts/check-objective-proofs.sh proofs --pin`;
# an added, removed, restated, redefined or re-axiomed row needs a line in scripts/gates/objective-contract-decisions.txt.

column8: ℕ → List UInt8 → List UInt8 → Option ℕ → Option ℕ → Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.EnrolmentEntry

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} (self : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical), physical.canonicalBytes (Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.cellIdOf deployment) = Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.cellBytes self.cell

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} (loaded : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical), Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.cellRoot loaded.cell = physical.model.roots (Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.cellIdOf deployment)

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} (loaded : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical) (post : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.Cell), Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.decodeCell (loaded.write post).canonicalPostBytes = Option.some post

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} (loaded : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical) (post : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.Cell), (loaded.write post).expectedPre = Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.cellRoot loaded.cell

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} (loaded : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical) (post : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.Cell), Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.rootBytes (loaded.write post).canonicalPostBytes = (loaded.write post).exactPost

Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest → Option Minidregg.Kernel.PayTariff.Tariff → ℕ → List Minidregg.Kernel.PayTariff.Address32 → Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.View
∀ {bytes : List UInt8} {cell : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.Cell}, Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.decodeCell bytes = Option.some cell → Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.cellBytes cell = bytes

∀ (deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment) (physical : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot) (cell : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.Cell), physical.canonicalBytes (Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.cellIdOf deployment) = Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.cellBytes cell → ∃ loaded, Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.load deployment physical = Option.some loaded ∧ loaded.cell = cell

∀ (deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment) (physical : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot), Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.decodeCell (physical.canonicalBytes (Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.cellIdOf deployment)) = Option.none → Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.load deployment physical = Option.none

∀ (store : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.PayStore) (miniKey : List UInt8) (record : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.EnrolRecord), (miniKey, record) ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.enrolments store ↔ Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.enrolmentAt store miniKey = Option.some record

∀ (store : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.PayStore) (key : List UInt8) (row : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.Unattributed), (key, row) ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.journals store ↔ Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.journalAt store key = Option.some row

{deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} → {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} → (cell : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.Cell) → physical.canonicalBytes (Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.cellIdOf deployment) = Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.cellBytes cell → Minidregg.Kernel.PayCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical
